reuse.why: The actions reuse category selection, spending conversion, batching and undo helpers, but isFixedCostGroup reimplements tag recognition instead of using extractTagsFromText.

duplication.why: Eligibility rules remain centralized, with one duplicated responsibility in the custom group-note tag matcher.

placement.why: Budget eligibility and amount calculation stay in budget actions, while method registration uses the existing application layer.

scope.why: The changes are confined to the requested month-wide actions, their registration, tests and release note.

maintainability.why: The shared eligibility predicate makes future exclusions straightforward, but tag recognition should use the existing shared definition.

disguised_duplication.where: isFixedCostGroup reshapes existing note-tag recognition into a specialized regular expression rather than sharing extractTagsFromText.

abstraction_drift.where: includeHiddenCategories adds one parameter each to isMonthFillTarget and getMonthFillCategories; the predicate gains template, fixed-group and include-hidden branches, while isFixedCostGroup independently implements shared tag recognition.
